name: AlphaLearn
description_en:
AlphaLearn is an employee-training LMS with cloud and on-premise offerings. It combines course delivery, assessment, completion tracking and AI-assisted course creation, with particular positioning for Indian organizations.

Cloud subscription and a self-managed perpetual license are different operating choices. The learning workflow and total cost depend on learner count, deployment and the integrations actually required.
description_zh:
AlphaLearn 是员工培训 LMS，提供云服务与本地部署，结合课程交付、考核、完成跟踪及 AI 辅助创课，尤其面向印度组织。

云订阅和自行管理的永久许可是不同运营选择，学习流程与总成本取决于人数、部署方式和实际所需集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Import standards-based content and track assigned training.
core_features.explanation_zh: 导入标准内容并跟踪分配的培训。

core_features.explanation_en: A document or topic can become structured learning material for review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档或主题可生成待审核的结构化教材。

core_features.explanation_en: Deployment choice changes hosting and maintenance responsibilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 部署方式改变托管和维护责任。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Custom INR quote by learner count and deployment; cloud subscription versus perpetual Enterprise license with optional maintenance.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按人数和部署方式提供 INR 定制报价；云订阅与可选维护的永久 Enterprise 许可不同。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: AlphaLearn describes importing SCORM 1.2/2004 content, video and live sessions, assigning training by role or department, and tracking completion. Its AI workflow starts with a topic or document and generates a structured draft with learning objectives and checks. The homepage distinguishes managed Cloud from an on-premise or private-cloud installation. Do not infer that generating a draft establishes instructional correctness.
sections.zh: AlphaLearn 介绍导入 SCORM 1.2/2004、视频和实时课程，按角色或部门分配培训并跟踪完成。AI 流程从主题或文档生成包含目标及知识检查的结构化草稿。首页区分托管 Cloud 和本地或私有云部署，生成草稿并不证明教学内容正确。

sections.en: Use an approved safety document to create a draft, then have a subject expert verify its procedures and quiz answers. Enroll a pilot cohort, complete the course as a learner and check that the expected completion and assessment evidence appears in reports. Test a failed quiz and an interrupted mobile session as well. These are recommended acceptance cases, not tests performed for this profile.
sections.zh: 可用已批准的安全文档生成草稿，再由主题专家检查操作步骤和测验答案。登记试点学员，以学习者身份完成课程，核对报告是否有预期完成和考核证据。还应检查测验失败及移动会话中断。本例是建议验收场景，本文未执行。

sections.title_en: A learner quote, not a published flat rate
sections.title_zh: 按学员询价，而非公开固定价格
sections.en: The pricing page offers a custom INR quote. Cloud is described as an annual subscription per enrolled learner; Enterprise as a one-time license by user count, with an optional Annual Maintenance Contract. A later comparison also mentions active-user monthly pricing, so the contractual meter needs explicit confirmation. Generic industry price ranges on the page are not AlphaLearn prices. Hosting, operations and maintenance remain relevant even with a perpetual license.
sections.zh: 定价页提供 INR 定制报价，Cloud 描述为按登记学员计费的年度订阅，Enterprise 则按人数一次性许可，可选年度维护合同。后面的对照又提到按活跃用户月付，因此合同计量方式需明确确认。页面上的行业价格区间不是 AlphaLearn 报价。永久许可也仍需考虑托管、运维与维护。

sections.title_en: Validate reporting and integration before rollout
sections.title_zh: 推广前验证报告与集成
sections.en: Start by choosing deployment, an administrator and the source of learner identities. The website lists HRMS and API integration, but field mapping, account lifecycle and error handling require project-specific checks. AlphaLearn is relevant to structured workforce training; a completion certificate alone does not prove a person can perform a regulated task. Exact contractual data location, license redistribution rights, backup restoration and current support obligations remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先选择部署方式、管理员和学员身份来源。网站列出 HRMS 与 API 接入，但字段映射、账户生命周期和异常处理需按项目检查。它适合结构化员工培训，但完成证书本身不能证明具备受监管工作的能力。合同数据位置、许可再分发权、备份恢复和当前支持义务仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Confirm enrolled versus active-user metering and the actual Cloud/Enterprise contract, infrastructure and integration costs.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认登记与活跃用户计量，以及实际云或 Enterprise 合同、基础设施和集成费用。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
